EmailTemplate.name: General Admission Requirements for Cronkite
EmailTemplate.subject: Discover more about the Cronkite experience
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thanks for your interest in Arizona State University’s Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication.
Our school is one of several at ASU with higher admission standards than the university admission requirement. Entering freshmen must have a minimum 3.00 ABOR high school GPA and no English deficiencies (four years of high school English). Freshmen must also meet one of the following minimum composite test scores:
1040 SAT or higher 22 ACT or higher
Please note that we do not consider the writing portion of either standardized test. Incoming freshmen may qualify as a Dean’s Admit to the Cronkite School if their test scores or GPA fall slightly below our minimum requirements. These decisions are made once all documents have been received and processed by ASU.
We have an additional pathway to Cronkite for students who are not directly admitted for their first semester, and we’d be happy to discuss that option with you.
In the meantime, you may learn more about the Cronkite School’s undergraduate admission requirements (https://cronkite.asu.edu/undergrad/admissions) and explore our 11 professional programs (https://cronkite.asu.edu/professional-programs).
Cronkite students benefit from hands-on, immersive experiences and opportunities beginning in their first semester at ASU, with access to our state-of-the-art facilities and guidance from award-winning faculty.
We also encourage you to discover the Cronkite experience through a program featurette produced by our students (https://vimeo.com/126430351).
For more information about the Cronkite School, please call me at {!User.Phone}.
Sincerely,
{!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName} {!User.Title} Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
